actuation: same acceleration inverse and measured pedal feedback in every arm
selection: minimum mean gap RMSE among shorter candidates with complete safe episodes and speed RMSE within the margin; ties choose the larger time headway
primary_test_metric: gap RMSE, mean over seeds within track, then tracks within acquisition run, then equal acquisition runs
safety: all candidate episodes complete safely; retain and report every outcome in both arms
adoption: upper paired 95 percent run bootstrap interval below zero, complete pairs in every selected run, at least 22 complete tracks, all candidate episodes complete safely, speed RMSE within the margin, and absolute mean signed gap bias no worse
scope: independent site transfer with fixed C3 and inverse; existing US 101 observations are development data
